verdict.rationale: Unreal exposes a broad programmatic surface. Python editor scripting can automate asset tasks, actor placement and import pipelines and drive the editor from custom UIs, backed by a generated per-class API reference. The Remote Control HTTP/WebSocket API can call any Blueprint-callable function, and the CLI and UAT handle cooking, packaging, deploying and testing. Nothing, however, documents true UI parity: the Python API is marked Experimental, and Remote Control reaches only Blueprint-callable or preset-exposed functionality. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party claim or demonstration that every editor UI action is reachable via API, a stable (non-experimental) Python API, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
